_handoff.scope: Citizen-evidence pass for Bengaluru municipal trade-licence new and renewal routes. Searches did not identify a sufficiently specific, public first-person application account that could be retained without promoting consultant marketing, anonymous allegations, or non-citizen reporting to evidence. No personal data was collected.

claims.text: No usable public first-person account was identified in this pass that establishes a Bengaluru municipal trade-licence application, renewal, inspection, payment, or issue outcome.
claims.notes: Only public, first-person evidence was in scope. Consultant pages, generic forum assertions and reporting without a usable first-person account were excluded.

roadblocks.title: No retained citizen application account
roadblocks.symptom: Citizen evidence does not currently substantiate a lived trade-licence route or failure mode.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Unknown; absence from this pass is not evidence that the public workflow is easy, difficult, available, or unavailable.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the official and public-workflow handoffs for verified process leads; add a redacted, attributable first-person account only if one is later found.
